basic_profile.bio: I'm a long-time Redditor and a dedicated learner, currently residing in Wellington, New Zealand. With a background in biological sciences, I work as a research assistant at a local university. I have a keen interest in genetics and evolutionary biology. Outside of work, I am a huge fan of classic rock, with Black Sabbath being my all-time favorite band. As a parent of two, I often spend my weekends exploring the beautiful outdoors with my family. I am usually online during the evenings, balancing my Reddit time with family commitments. I am married to my college sweetheart, and we share a passion for sustainable living and financial planning.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in biological sciences, specifically in genetics and evolutionary biology. This knowledge stems from my academic journey, which includes both undergraduate and master's degrees in biology. Additionally, my work as a research assistant has further honed my skills and understanding in this field. I also have a good grasp of financial planning, which I picked up from managing my family's finances.
